## File: facebookresearch_projectariatools/examples/Gen1/python_samples/eyegaze_depth_estimator/eye_gaze_depth_estimator.py

Prompts

```
['run the eye gaze depth estimator on a VRS file with eye gaze data to estimate depth', 'create a GazeDepthEstimator instance with a VRS data provider to compute gaze depth via patch matching', 'get depth scores and estimates for a single eye gaze sample using the GazeDepthEstimator', 'export a list of GazeWithDepthEstimate objects to a CSV file with gaze and depth columns', 'project 3D CPF points to 2D image sensor coordinates using camera calibration and extrinsics']
```

Usage

```
{'run_eyegaze_depth_estimator': 'run the eye gaze depth estimator on a VRS file with eye gaze data to estimate depth', 'create_GazeDepthEstimator': 'create a GazeDepthEstimator instance with a VRS data provider to compute gaze depth via patch matching', 'get_depth_scores_for_gaze': 'get depth scores and estimates for a single eye gaze sample using the GazeDepthEstimator', 'export_to_csv': 'export a list of GazeWithDepthEstimate objects to a CSV file with gaze and depth columns', 'get_image_projections': 'project 3D CPF points to 2D image sensor coordinates using camera calibration and extrinsics'}
```
